content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply for WAMUL Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Desirable: Deputy Manager: relevant experience in dairy industry, cooperative organization, agriculture sector, rural development, milk procurement or allied sectors preferred Deputy Manager: working experience in preparing DPRs, project proposals, analytical reports, management presentations, large scale data processing, MIS dashboards and data-driven decision-making Deputy Manager: field level experience, particularly among rural mass, an added advantage

rows.qualification: Educational Qualification: BE/B.Tech in Food Technology /Dairy Technology /Dairy Engineering/Agricultural Engineering/BVSc from a recognized University/Institution. Candidates having post graduate degree in MBA/Executive MBA/PG Diploma in Management, preferably in Operations, Rural Management, Agribusiness, and Supply Chain or in relevant discipline along with the above-mentioned qualification shall be an added advantage.
rows.experience: Experience: Minimum 5 years of full-time relevant professional experience in Food Technology/ Dairy Technology/ Dairy Engineering/ Milk Procurement Operations/ MIS/Data Analytics/ Project Management or related functions. Relevant experience in dairy industry, cooperative organization, agriculture sector, rural development, milk procurement or allied sectors shall be preferred. Working Experience in preparing of DPRs, project proposals, analytical reports, management presentations, large scale data processing and management, maintaining MIS dashboards and data-driven decision-making. Having field level experience, particularly among rural mass shall be an added advantage

rows.qualification: Full time B.Tech in Dairy Technology from a reputed education Institute/University. Minimum 3 years' full time experience in processing and manufacturing of milk and milk products in a Dairy Plant having capacity of minimum 1 lakh liters per day.
